result.summary: The page is generally well laid out, but the promotional banner has a significant readability problem and inactive bottom navigation labels are very faint.

issues.description: The white headline and subtitle in the pale green promotional banner have extremely low contrast against the background, making the offer and checkout code difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use a much darker text color, darken the banner background substantially, or place the text over a darker/opaque overlay to achieve accessible contrast.

issues.description: The inactive bottom navigation icons and labels (Search, Orders, and Profile) are rendered in very light gray on white, reducing legibility and making the controls appear disabled.
issues.suggestion: Increase the contrast of inactive navigation icons and label text while retaining a clear visual distinction from the active tab.
